description: Paid: 0.01 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Conditions for one model category (prices, limits, listing events, vendor status) as declared by public sources. Not a ranking. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_model_category
title: Model category conditions (paid: 0.01 RLUSD or 0.01 USDC on Base via x402)
